title: Simplicial Volume and Scalar Curvature on Closed Kähler Surfaces
summary: Let $M$ be a closed Kähler surface. We prove that every Riemannian metric $g$ on $M$ with $\operatorname{Sc}_g\geq-λ^2$, where $λ\geq 0$, satisfies $$ \lVert M\rVert\leq \frac{27}{2}\,λ^4\operatorname{vol}_g(M). $$ This proves Gromov's quantitative scalar-curvature--simplicial-volume conjecture for closed Kähler surfaces. We also construct infinitely many non-Kähler symplectic 4-manifolds of general type with positive simplicial volume for which the same estimate holds.
